name: codeweave
description: Evidence-driven architecture audits, dependency untangling and behaviour-preserving refactoring of existing codebases: change-driver analysis (hidden links, needless links, surplus, special cases), reversible verified slices, optional comment/test curation, a decision log, and read-only repo-map and Git co-change scripts.
